title: Engineered wood products.
officialText:
Prefabricated wood I-joists, structural glued-laminated timber and structural
composite lumber shall not be notched or drilled except where permitted by the manufacturer’s recommendations or
where the effects of such alterations are specifically considered in the design of the member by a registered design
professional.
